# cursor Provider

Manage Cursor Automations, Origin repository rulesets, Origin repository and owner grants, Origin owner SSH certificate authorities, and Origin namespace inbound IP allowlists, and read Origin repositories. Automations use the Cursor Automations API over Connect RPC. Origin calls use the public Origin API and the same auth token. Grants keyed by user_email or group_name also need the Team or Organization Admin API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    cursor = {
      source  = "cursor/cursor"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "cursor" {
  # Or set the CURSOR_TOKEN environment variable.
  token = var.cursor_token

  # Only needed for Origin grants keyed by user_email or group_name.
  # Or set CURSOR_TEAM_API_KEY and CURSOR_ORGANIZATION_API_KEY.
  team_api_key         = var.cursor_team_api_key
  organization_api_key = var.cursor_organization_api_key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Cursor API base URL. Defaults to https://api2.cursor.sh. Can also be set via CURSOR_ENDPOINT.
- `organization_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Organization Admin API key, sent as HTTP Basic auth (key as username, empty password) to https://api.cursor.com/organizations/groups. Required only to resolve group_name on Origin grants. Can also be set via CURSOR_ORGANIZATION_API_KEY.
- `team_api_key` (String, Sensitive) Team Admin API key, sent as HTTP Basic auth (key as username, empty password) to https://api.cursor.com/teams/members. Required only to resolve user_email on Origin grants. Can also be set via CURSOR_TEAM_API_KEY.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Auth token for the Cursor API. Can also be set via CURSOR_TOKEN.
